group.title: A community grant application
group.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — WESTBOROUGH SMALL PROJECT GRANTS
Applications close at 5 p.m. on May 30. Registered community groups may request up to $2,000 for projects completed by September 30. Funds may cover materials and equipment hire, but not food, permanent staff salaries, or work already completed. Applicants must provide a detailed budget and written permission from the property owner. Decisions will be emailed on June 20. Successful applicants must submit receipts and photographs within 30 days of completion.

DOCUMENT 2 — PROJECT PROPOSAL DRAFT
Applicant: Canal Neighbours Association
Project: Transform the unused paved corner behind the public library into a container garden.
Work date: August 17, with August 24 reserved for bad weather.
Volunteers will assemble movable planters and fill them with herbs for residents to pick. The library director has signed a letter permitting use of the corner, provided the emergency exit remains clear. The project does not involve removing paving or drilling into the library wall.
Budget: planter materials $960; soil and plants $540; tool hire $180; volunteer lunch $120. Total: $1,800.

DOCUMENT 3 — EMAIL
From: Council Grants Officer
To: Canal Neighbours Association
Date: May 22
Thank you for sending your draft for an informal check. The permission letter is sufficient. Please revise the requested amount to exclude the ineligible budget item; you may pay for that separately using your association's funds. Also add a sketch showing the emergency-exit route. A professional drawing is not necessary. Once these changes are made, submit the final application through the online portal before the deadline. Sending this draft by email does not count as a formal application.
group.passageZh:
文件一：Westborough 小型專案補助
申請五月三十日下午五點截止。已登記社區團體可申請最高兩千元，專案須最遲於九月三十日完成。可補助材料和設備租賃，不補助食物、固定員工薪資及已完成工作。須附詳細預算與場地所有人的書面許可。六月二十日以電子郵件通知結果。獲補助者完工後三十天內須交收據與照片。

文件二：提案草稿
申請者：Canal 鄰里協會。
專案：將公共圖書館後方閒置鋪面角落改為盆栽花園。
施工日八月十七日，天候不佳時改至八月二十四日。
志工組裝可移式花盆，種植香草供居民採摘。館長已簽許可，但緊急出口須保持暢通。不移除鋪面，也不在牆上鑽孔。
預算：花盆材料九百六十元、土壤及植物五百四十元、工具租賃一百八十元、志工午餐一百二十元，總計一千八百元。

文件三：郵件
市議會補助承辦人五月二十二日寄給協會。
謝謝先寄來草稿供初步檢視。許可函已足夠。請調整申請金額，排除不合資格項目；該項可由協會自有資金另付。也請加上緊急出口路線草圖，不須專業製圖。修改後須於期限前透過線上申請系統送出正式申請；寄送草稿郵件不算正式申請。
